query:
UPDATE deployments
         SET heartbeat_at = ?
         WHERE id = ?
           AND status IN ('queued', 'pulling', 'starting', 'checking')
           AND EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM apps
               WHERE apps.id = deployments.app_id
                 AND apps.lock_token = deployments.id
                 AND apps.lock_expires_at > ?
           )
